item.title: T-Mass and Core Density — System Mass and Capital Concentration
item.description:
T-Mass and Core Density (Heavy Nine)

In Antigravity Cosmology: Total System Mass (T-Mass) and Core Gravitational Density (Heavy Nine / Core Density). In Classical Language: Total combined market capitalization of NASDAQ-100 components and index concentration in megacap tech (> $1T market cap).

What T-Mass Really Is

T-Mass (Total Mass) is the aggregate market capitalization of all 100 NASDAQ-100 companies, measured in US Dollar Trillions.

The 24h Session Delta reflects the net capital inflow or outflow across the entire US tech sector.
